item.title: Agentless VSS and SQL Server backup now available in Plakar
item.description: VSS and SQL Server backups are now free for registered Plakar users: agentless over SSH, encrypted and deduplicated into an open, portable Kloset store. The connectors are closed source, built for Control Plane. Active Directory recovery is a Plakar Control Plane capability.

item.title: 10 Reasons You Need an Independent, Offsite Backup in 2026
item.description: Cloud storage isn’t a backup strategy. 10 reasons you need an independent, offsite backup you control, from ransomware and rogue AI agents to climate, conflict, and storage cost.
